name: High-Angle_Robust_Fast_FaceAlignment
description: HRFFA: High-Angle Robust Fast Face Alignment. Whole-head face alignment dataset & training pipeline.

paragraphs: A training, distillation and ONNX deployment pipeline for whole-head face alignment that stays robust at extreme head poses while remaining light enough for CPU inference.

Left: teacher vitl-320 on nine looking-up × profile tiles with a roll of 0–320° composited onto each tile. Right: student vitt-256 on measured pitch extremes (+86° to −89°) with roll. Predictions only.
features: Face alignment on head crops, not face crops. Conventional face-alignment papers assume a tightly cropped face region; this is a special-purpose model that works on a crop of the whole head instead. The architecture is…

For head crops that include looking up / looking down (measured pitch beyond ±85°), in-plane rotation over the full 360° roll, and profile views (yaw ±90°), the models output 68 / 98 / 29 landmarks plus a 3-class…

The teacher is a DINOv3 ViT-L/16 (320×320); the students are a ViT-T/16 (256 and 96 input) and a PP-HGNetV2-B0 based CNN (256 and 96 input). Students are trained by online distillation from the teacher and exported to…
Of the total inference time, 25 ms is spent on CUDA inference for DEIMv2-Wholebody49-S, while the remainder is spent on FaceAlignment inference.
